100:t_006:2.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「We came into space without any preparations. If this keeps up...!」

100:t_008:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「This is $$ソレスタルビーイング$$. We will provide support now.」

100:t_008:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Your timing is perfect! That helps us!」

100:t_008:2.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「It's a moving reunion. Let's crown it with a victory.」

100:t_008:3.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「It looks like they've had a rough time these past two months too.」

100:t_008:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Now that $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has begun to move, we have little time left.」

100:t_008:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, intercept $$ネオ・ジオン$$ while supporting the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.」

100:t_010:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's the $$キュベレイ$$...! $$ハマーン・カーン$$!」

100:t_010:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ハマーン$$... I never expected you to come to the front lines...」

100:t_010:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$... She's the one $$シャア・アズナブル$$ entrusted $$ネオ・ジオン$$ to...」

100:t_010:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$ソレスタルビーイング$$ is here too...? How convenient.」

100:t_010:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't misunderstand. I want to talk to you.」

100:t_010:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Be quiet, Captain $$アンジェロ$$.」

100:t_010:13.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, its pilot, and $$ソレスタルビーイング$$... Come over to my side.」

100:t_010:15.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...What do you mean by that?」

100:t_010:16.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I can't explain now. First, you must come to my side.」

100:t_010:17.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$. Don't think you can get people to act like that.」

100:t_010:18.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「This is none of your business, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$.」

100:t_010:19.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Now... Let me hear your answer.」

100:t_010:21.en:
$$オットー$$
「Wait... You can't just spring this on us...」

100:t_010:22.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I wasn't asking the Captain. ...Answer me, $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

100:t_010:26.en:
$$オットー$$
「They're the sort who'll use force if we refuse anyway! Don't hold back!」

100:t_010:28.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! You little...!!」

100:t_010:29.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This $$ユニコーン$$ was entrusted to me! I won't hand it over to anyone unless I'm convinced it's right!」

100:t_010:30.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s answer is the same, $$ハマーン$$. If you're proposing we fight together, show us something that makes you worthy of our trust.」

100:t_010:32.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop, $$ハマーン$$! For us to fight now...」

100:t_010:33.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That is precisely why I'll win it by force...!」

100:t_010:34.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$刹那$$! $$ロックオン$$, $$アレルヤ$$, $$ティエリア$$!」

100:t_010:35.en:
$$刹那$$
「I know! Our target is $$ハマーン・カーン$$!」

100:t_010:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, target $$ハマーン$$! We'll stop her and find out what $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is after!」

100:t_011:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I should have known it wouldn't be easy.」

100:t_011:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「This will call for a suitable strategy.」

100:t_011:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're being far too familiar, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$.」

100:t_011:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Answer me! Do you know where the Colonel is!?」

100:t_011:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Colonel is sure to help bring Earth and space together!」

100:t_011:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems you overestimate that man too.」

100:t_011:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wait, $$ハマーン$$! I want to talk!」

100:t_011:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'm your enemy! Don't act as though we're friends!」

100:t_012:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
(Damn $$ハマーン・カーン$$... What is she thinking...?)

100:t_013:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「All $$ネオ・ジオン$$ units have withdrawn.」

100:t_013:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Now we can catch our breath...」

100:t_013:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「But why did $$ハマーン・カーン$$ want to contact us...?」

100:t_013:3.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「I hear she's a $$ニュータイプ$$ too. Maybe she's taken an interest in $$刹那$$?」

100:t_013:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$刹那$$... Do you have any idea why?」

100:t_013:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Captain $$スメラギ$$... Does your coming here mean you'll lend us a hand?」

100:t_013:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Yes. If we keep fighting isolated battles, we'll only fall further behind.」

100:t_013:8.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To break through this situation, I propose we concentrate our forces, prepared to accept losses.」

100:t_013:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「I understand. First, let's join up and exchange information.」

100:t_013:10.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$ラプラスの箱$$... $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is still pursuing it...)

100:t_013:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Even in this situation, will the war between Earth and space still continue...?)

100:t_013:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$オードリー$$... Where are you now...?)

100:t_014:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Tch...! Has the $$ギラ・ズール$$ reached its limit too!?」

100:t_014:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Remember this, $c...! Our true battle begins today!」

100:t_015:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(If that man is here, does that mean $$フル・フロンタル$$ is still alive after all...?)

100:t_100:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Why are you targeting the $$ユニコーン$$!? What meaning does it have on Earth as it is now!?」

100:t_100:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$カミーユ・ビダン$$! If I defeat you, $$ギュネイ$$ will be bitter about it!」
